llm.summary: The skill gives narrowly scoped instructions for turning project images and prompts into short video clips, with no harmful behavior evident.

dimensions.detail: File and shell tools fit media processing, though the video-generation backend and any associated data transfers are unspecified.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only Markdown instructions, with no installer, bundled executable, or dependency download.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions explicitly limit work to image-to-video generation and prohibit changing storyboards or generating replacement still images.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Only project video outputs are requested; no background workers, credential access, elevated privileges, or persistent agent changes are instructed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Reading shot images and prompts and writing matching video clips directly support its stated pipeline role.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Confirm which video-generation service will process your images and prompts, including its privacy terms and costs. The scanner's unresolved file reference points to expected project inputs, not a missing executable dependency.
